display_long_description:
# 👑 WHO’S THE KING 👑

🪑 Sit on the throne, grab your sword ⚔️, keep your eyes wide open 👀, and decide who gets to enter your kingdom. Every visitor matters… and every mistake could cost you your crown 👑💥.

[media]

# 🛡️ Protect your people🛡️
Plagues 🤒, criminals 🕵️‍♂️, traitors 😬 - danger is everywhere. Inspect newcomers 🔍, heal the sick 🧪, and stop threats before they spread like wildfire 🔥.

[media]

# ⚖️ Judge. Decide. Execute. ⚖️

Search suspects 🧳, treat the wounded 🩹, cut off gangrened limbs 🪓, throw criminals into the dungeon 🏰…
And if justice demands it? Off with their heads 😵‍💫⚔️.

[media]

# 🩷 👑 Choose your Queen!  👑 🩷

Ruling alone is boring, why not make one of your visitors your queen? Give her items, maybe she'll react differently!

[media]

# 🔥 Avoid the Revolution! 🔥 
The people are angry 😡. Be fair, be smart, or be ruthless - but don’t push them too far…
A bad king doesn’t last long 🪧🔥.

[media]

🎭 Cartoon chaos, twisted realism
A colorful, unhinged cartoon world 🤪 where power goes straight to your head. Absurd situations, dark humor, and impossible choices — just like Scan or Scam, but with a crown 👑.

Rule wisely… or lose everything.
So tell us - Who’s the King? 👀👑
